caps: Young Dasharatha | *KILLED A BOY* by mistake. | Years later, it killed *HIM.*
lines.tts: Young Dasharatha killed a boy by mistake. Years later, it killed him.

caps: Welcome to *PART 3* | of the *RAMAYAN* series.
lines.tts: Welcome to part three of the Ramayan series.

caps: Ram left for the forest | with *SITA* and *LAKSHMAN.*
All Ayodhya wept, | and the old king ran | *AFTER THE CHARIOT.*
lines.tts: Ram left for the forest with Sita and Lakshman. All Ayodhya wept, and the old king ran after the chariot.

caps: Days later, the charioteer | came back. | *ALONE.*
lines.tts: Days later, the charioteer came back. Alone.

caps: That night, Dasharatha | told queen *KAUSALYA* | a secret.
lines.tts: That night, Dasharatha told queen Kausalya a secret.

caps: As a prince, he had | a rare skill: | hitting a target *BY SOUND.*
lines.tts: As a prince, he had a rare skill: hitting a target by sound.

caps: One rainy night by the *SARAYU,* | he heard a sound, | like an *ELEPHANT* drinking.
lines.tts: One rainy night by the Sarayu, he heard a sound, like an elephant drinking.

caps: He shot. | And a *BOY* cried out.
lines.tts: He shot. And a boy cried out.

caps: A young ascetic, | filling a pot | for his *BLIND PARENTS.*
lines.tts: A young ascetic, filling a pot for his blind parents.

caps: Take them this water, | he said, | and *DIED.*
lines.tts: Take them this water, he said, and died.

caps: His parents asked: | Son, why so quiet?
And the prince | had to tell them | *THE TRUTH.*
lines.tts: His parents asked: Son, why so quiet? And the prince had to tell them the truth.

caps: The father cursed him: | You too will die | *GRIEVING FOR YOUR SON.*
lines.tts: The father cursed him: You too will die, grieving for your son.

caps: Back then, | Dasharatha had | *NO SON AT ALL.*
lines.tts: Back then, Dasharatha had no son at all.

caps: Now, crying for *RAM,* | the king died | *THAT VERY NIGHT.*
lines.tts: Now, crying for Ram, the king died that very night.

caps: *NEXT, PART 4:* in the forest, | a crow attacks Sita,
and Ram picks up | a *BLADE OF GRASS.*
lines.tts: Next, part four. In the forest, a crow attacks Sita, and Ram picks up a blade of grass.

caps: *FOLLOW* | so you don't miss it,
and comment | *JAI SHRI RAM!*
lines.tts: Follow, so you don't miss it, and comment, Jai Shri Ram!
